title: Power BI Dashboard Specialist - Jr to Mid - Remote - Must be a US Citizen
job_description:
Dashboard Development and Data Visualization Modern - Power BI Specialist

The mission support relies on transparent, data-driven decision making. To meet this need, the Contractor will design and implement intuitive dashboards that present real-time insights into key performance indicators and overall system health. These dashboards will not only enhance transparency and accountability but will also empower decision-makers at all levels to monitor trends, allocate resources more effectively, and act quickly in response to operational changes. The use of advanced visualization tools, such as Microsoft Power BI, ensures user friendly interfaces that support both technical and non-technical audiences. Contractor personnel support may include, but is not limited to:

Develop Power BI dashboard to monitor key performance indicators and system performance. Ensure dashboards support real-time analytics, secure role based access, and customizable reporting.

Apply UI/UX design principles to create visually engaging and easy-to-navigate dashboards.

Collaborate with data analysts, internal developers and other stakeholders to implement visions on new dashboards, enhance existing dashboards and create new data visualizations.

Advise on opportunities for new dashboard development and operational integration.

The ultimate goal is to utilize existing data to build dashboards that are intuitive, clearly convey data and information they are intended to convey and are easy to maintain with a focus on advanced dashboards that are visually appealing.

When requested, the Contractor shall create, design, and produce high-impact, professional, graphical representations of various information and data analysis.

The Contractor shall use abstract data, aggregate data, or any blend of data to develop interactive dashboards or stories, into attractive visualizations and infographics, as directed by the Government.
